M6-full: Sparse 2:4 GPU test status
=====================================

Source YAML located
-------------------
A gfx950-compatible sparse GEMM kernel YAML was located at:

  Tensile/Tests/common/sparse/gfx94x/spmm_fp16_mi16.yaml
    Sparse: 1, fp16 HPA, NN (TransposeA=False, TransposeB=False)
    Skip marks: skip-gfx900-9xx and skip-gfx1xxx (gfx950 NOT excluded)
    MI [16,16,32,1,1,1,1,1,1], DepthU=32
    Sizes: [16,16,1,16] and [256,256,1,32]

A client-side reference YAML was created at:

  Tensile/client/tests/yaml/gemm_sparse_gpu.yaml
    Same ProblemType and ForkParams, size kept at [256,256,1,32].
    NOTE: GPU dispatch is not yet implemented (see below).

Why GPU sparse tests remain skipped
-------------------------------------
The sparse GEMM kernel expects:
  - A compressed matrix (K/2 columns, uint8 or fp16 dtype)
  - A metadata tensor (uint8, shape M x (K/8)) encoding the 2:4 sparsity pattern
  - These pointers appear after the B pointer in singleCallArgs

gemm_args.py does not yet support this sparse arg layout.  The standard
_buildPointers function packs D, C, A, B only; it does not handle the
compressed_A + metadata slots that the sparse kernel reads.

To enable GPU sparse tests:
1. Add sparse pointer slots to _buildPointers in gemm_args.py:
     if sparse:
         buf += _packPtr(tensors.get("compressed_A", 0))
         buf += _packPtr(tensors.get("metadata", 0))
2. Add sparse stride slots to _buildStrides.
3. In the test, allocate GPU buffers for compressed_A and metadata,
   populate them using compress24() from Tensile/client/sparse.py.
4. Use gemmFp16 on the decompressed A (via decompress24) for reference.

CPU compress/decompress tests
------------------------------
TestCompress24 and TestDecompress24FromKnown in test_gemm_sparse.py
fully test the compress24/decompress24 helpers in Tensile/client/sparse.py.
These are CPU-only and pass without any GPU.
